name: GroundSnapper
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play "keep this sitting on the ground" behavior — raycasts straight down and repositions the object onto whatever surface is below it, optionally tilting to match the surface's slope. Different from Toolkit.EditorTools.GreyboxPlacer (an EDITOR-TIME click-to-place tool): this runs at runtime, continuously or on-demand, for things like a spawned prop settling onto uneven terrain or a character that should stay glued to a slope instead of floating/clipping.

src_serialized.name: raycastHeight
src_serialized.tooltip: The raycast starts this far ABOVE the object's current position — needs to be higher than anything the object could already be embedded in, or the downward ray could start under the ground and miss it entirely.

src_serialized.name: alignToNormal
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, also rotates the object so its up vector matches the ground's surface normal (e.g. tilting to match a slope). If false, only the position changes.

src_serialized.name: snapEveryFrame
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, snaps every frame (for something standing on moving/uneven ground). If false, call SnapToGround() yourself (e.g. once, right after spawning).

src_members.name: SnapToGround
src_members.comment: Returns true if a ground surface was actually found and the object was moved onto it.
